answer: The native invoke boundary can prevent the measured immediate View2D mutation without a suppression lease or source reorder. This is structurally viable as an explicit bounded navigation policy. Current events do not carry the required physical provenance; mixed-source coalescence and intentional custom View2D invocation are concrete policy limits. No unqualified safety or workflow completion is established.
